chapter_title: THE GUPTA ERA AN AGE OF TIRELESS CREATIVITY

items.point: The Gupta Empire was the most powerful and flourished from the 3rd to the 6th century CE, with its capital at Pāṭaliputra (present-day Patna).
The Iron Pillar of Delhi is over 1,600 years old and stands tall without rusting due to a unique protective layer formed by special iron and oxygen from the air.
